workflow_chains.description: Default deterministic local Goal operation path through GoalOperationService, PlanExecutionService, StaticPlanScheduler, CapabilityAdmission, deterministic executor, deterministic gates, and GoalExecution completion.

Explicit real-Agent pilot path using run_real_agent_pilot.py, real Planner output validation, real Executor budget normalization, GoalOperationService, BoundedTaskExecutor, TaskHarness, Codex AgentDriver, and pilot scorecard.
Task governance path from task.md/state/events/manifests to review and independent EvidenceGate completion.

defects.signal: Mode C repetitions reached internal bounded Executor timeout and the isolated child process could remain alive until the outer watchdog.
defects.current_handling: AgentDriver phases now run outside the scheduler event loop with bounded cancellation grace and daemon default-executor isolation.
defects.recommended_next_action: Keep regression coverage; no separate follow-up needed unless new cancellation evidence appears.

defects.signal: Bounded-write Executor task construction did not preserve exact PlanIR filesystem.write and expectedOutputs obligations.
defects.current_handling: Literal filesystem.write resources and expectedOutputs now become TaskSpec requirements, acceptance criteria, and internal artifact checks.
defects.recommended_next_action: Audit non-literal glob and multi-output cases before wider Mode C pilots.

defects.signal: Artifact-only Executor prompt allowed shell/process verification before returning WorkReport, pushing first completion beyond the idle window.
defects.current_handling: Executor prompt now states that required files must be created before final JSON and that shell/process verification is skipped for artifact-only/internal-check tasks.

defects.signal: Real Planner output could reintroduce bounded node timeout/budget values smaller than the observed real Executor completion window.
defects.layer: real Planner output to real Executor admission
defects.current_handling: The pilot normalizes real Executor bounded node budgets after real Planner output and before validation/writeback.
defects.recommended_next_action: Promote the real Executor budget invariant from pilot-only behavior into a documented admission/profile invariant, or document why the pilot is the only caller.

defects.signal: Internal artifact checks were counted as external process.exec requirements, and skipped semantic review was counted as a model call.
defects.current_handling: AHRA internal artifact checks do not consume process.exec capability; model call usage counts semantic review only when it actually ran.

defects.signal: Component inventory classifies standard-harness as legacy/non-default, but default-visible BoundedTaskExecutor imports and uses TaskHarness from standard_harness for real-Agent execution.
defects.layer: component lifecycle and real Executor dependency chain
defects.current_handling: No runtime break found in default M1. The risk is lifecycle ambiguity and accidental feature work in a documented legacy component.
defects.recommended_next_action: Open a narrow follow-up to either extract the Agent phase runner into a non-legacy bounded-agent component or reclassify/document the shared dependency explicitly.

defects.signal: Pilot hard metrics are coarse summaries derived largely from Goal status and fixed counters; they are insufficient as the sole evidence for broad Mode C stability.
defects.current_handling: EvidenceGate already limits TASK-0048 approval to one bounded rerun and rejects defaultization.
defects.recommended_next_action: Before broader Mode C pilots, add scorecard dimensions that separate contract, gate, budget, scheduler, provider, and model-behavior failures.

defects.signal: The repaired TaskSpec artifact obligation path currently treats only literal filesystem.write resources as required artifact paths.
defects.layer: PlanIR expectedOutputs and artifact path mapping
defects.current_handling: Literal bounded-write smoke is covered. Globs, directories, and richer expectedOutputs need explicit mapping rules before wider live use.
defects.recommended_next_action: Add a narrow invariant audit/test for non-literal outputs and multi-output contracts before a broad Mode C run.

defects.signal: Default M1 deterministic GoalVerificationService returns completion coverage for the M1 fixture profile, which is appropriate for M1 but must not be described as production semantic completion.
defects.current_handling: Current docs repeatedly state that M1 is deterministic/local and not production-grade distributed orchestration.
defects.recommended_next_action: Keep the boundary language; no code change needed in TASK-0049.

proposed_follow_up.title: Align real bounded Executor workflow dependencies and Mode C pilot invariants
scope: Resolve or explicitly document the BoundedTaskExecutor dependency on TaskHarness from a legacy-classified component.
Add tests or reports that make Mode C pilot failures separable across contract, gate, budget, scheduler, provider, and model-behavior classes.
Add invariant coverage for non-literal filesystem.write and multi-output expectedOutputs before wider Mode C pilots.
non_goals: Do not run a broad live Mode C pilot.
Do not package a release checkpoint.
